descricao_original: The submucosa consists of dense, irregular connective tissue containing larger blood vessels, nerves and lymphatics. In addition, the submucosa also contains the submucosal (Meissner’s) plexus which innervates the smooth muscle of the muscularis mucosae and regulates glandular secretions. 200x
creditos_identificados: Image source: The image was taken of a slide in the University of New England College of Osteopathic Medicine slide collection.
